description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a log view within a scrollable interface, handling text updates and layout setup for logging purposes in an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView and manages its display and updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
